content.scenario: A consumer approaches the Director of the Central Authority with a complaint against a company for false advertising. The Director, under the general control and supervision of the Director-General, exercises his powers to investigate the complaint.
content.outcome: The Director, subject to the general control, supervision, and direction of the Director-General, exercises his powers and discharges his functions to investigate the complaint and submit a report to the Central Authority.

user_queries: What are the powers of a Director under the Consumer Protection Act?
Can a Director investigate a consumer complaint independently?
What is the role of a Director in the Central Authority?
